book.name: 2 TESALONICENSES
book.title: U KAꞌBꞌ Uꞌ ITZꞌIBꞌA BꞌEN U PABLO XEꞌ QꞌU NIMAN TETZ U JESUUSTU TESALOONICA Ikaꞌv uꞌuj uvaꞌ itzꞌibꞌa bꞌen u Pablo te unqꞌa aa Tesalónica uvaꞌ ni niman u Jesús

content: Ni taqꞌ bꞌen u Pablo itzii

Ineꞌ in Pablo uvaꞌ ni qꞌiilan bꞌen ex, tukꞌ u Silvano tukꞌ u Timoteo. As nuntzꞌibꞌa bꞌen u yoleꞌ sete, ex aa Tesalónica, jankꞌal ex uvaꞌ atoꞌk ex kꞌatz u Kubꞌaal Tiixheꞌ tukꞌ kꞌatz u Kubꞌaal Jesucristo.
As ibꞌaꞌnil kuxh u Kubꞌaal Tiixheꞌ tukꞌ u Kubꞌaal Jesucristo tiꞌ uvaꞌ bꞌaꞌn etatin sevatzaj.
Vitzꞌin vatzik, ni qaqꞌ taꞌntiixh te u Tiixheꞌ setiꞌ, tan aꞌeꞌ bꞌaꞌn te Aak uvaꞌ ech la kubꞌaneꞌ setiꞌ, tan niyakꞌin veꞌt u kꞌujlebꞌal ekꞌuꞌleꞌ as tukꞌ u xoꞌniibꞌeꞌ sexoꞌl.

Estiꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ ni qoksa veꞌt eqꞌii xoꞌl unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ uveꞌ ni niman u Tiixheꞌ tu unjoltu unqꞌa tenameꞌ tan kꞌuxh nepalebꞌe kꞌaxkꞌo, as kꞌujleꞌl ekꞌuꞌl tiꞌ Aak. As tul nekuy unqꞌa kꞌaxkꞌoeꞌ uvaꞌ nepalebꞌe,

as aꞌeꞌ u kꞌuchbꞌal tetzeꞌ uvaꞌ jik chit kat ibꞌan u Tiixheꞌ tul kat taqꞌ Aak etokebꞌal xoꞌl u tenameꞌ uvaꞌ at jaqꞌ u tijleꞌm u Tiixheꞌ. As tiꞌ uvaꞌ at veꞌt ok ex xoꞌl vitenam Aakeꞌ, as estiꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ nepalebꞌekat unqꞌa kꞌaxkꞌoeꞌ.
As bꞌaꞌn te u Tiixheꞌ uvaꞌ la taqꞌ Aak ichꞌexel te unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ ni bꞌanon u vaꞌlexheꞌ sete.

As bꞌaꞌn la ibꞌan te Aak uvaꞌ la iꞌl veꞌt oꞌ setukꞌ vatz unqꞌa kꞌaxkꞌoeꞌ, oꞌ uvaꞌ kꞌaxbꞌinal veꞌt oꞌ. As aꞌ la ibꞌaneꞌ tul la ilpu veꞌt u tulebꞌal u Kubꞌaal Jesúseꞌ tul uvaꞌ la kuꞌ chꞌuꞌl Aak tu almikaꞌ tukꞌ viyakꞌileꞌ as tukꞌ unqꞌa ángel unpajte.
As la ul Aak tukꞌ mam xamal tiꞌ ul taqꞌat Aak ichꞌexel te unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌ kat niman u Tiixheꞌ. As yeꞌ kat inima kam uvaꞌ ni tal u bꞌaꞌnla yoleꞌ tiꞌ u Kubꞌaal Jesucristo.

As aꞌ uxhchileꞌ uveꞌ la ul u kꞌaxkꞌoeꞌ stiꞌ, umaꞌl u kꞌaxkꞌo uvaꞌ yeꞌl iyaꞌtebꞌal. Tan la eesal veꞌt el unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ vatz u Jesús, as yeꞌ la isakꞌ veꞌteꞌ tu uveꞌ ni toksalkat iqꞌii Aak, as yeꞌl tokebꞌal tiꞌ vinimla yakꞌil u Jesús

tu u qꞌiieꞌ uvaꞌ la ulkat Aak. As la oksal iqꞌii Aak tiꞌ u nimla bꞌaꞌnileꞌ uvaꞌ kat ibꞌan Aak sqiꞌ, jankꞌal oꞌ uvaꞌ oꞌ itenam Aak, tan nim talchu Aak. As la chit teqꞌo qaama stiꞌ, oꞌ uvaꞌ oꞌ niman tetz Aak setukꞌ, tan kat enima u bꞌaꞌnla yoleꞌ tiꞌ vibꞌaꞌnil Aakeꞌ uvaꞌ kat qal sete.

Estiꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ nu kunach Tiixh setiꞌ sbꞌenemeen, aqꞌal uvaꞌ la til Aak u bꞌaꞌneꞌ uvaꞌ nebꞌaneꞌ. As la txuqꞌtxun veꞌt Aak tiꞌ uvaꞌ kat imolo ex Aak. As Aakeꞌ la lochon ex tiꞌ etzojpisat unqꞌa bꞌaꞌnileꞌ uvaꞌ netitzꞌa, tan tiꞌ uvaꞌ kꞌujleꞌl ekꞌuꞌl tiꞌ Aak.

As nu kunach Tiixh setiꞌ, aqꞌal uvaꞌ la oksal veꞌt iqꞌii u Kubꞌaal Jesucristoeꞌ tiꞌ unqꞌa bꞌaꞌneꞌ uveꞌ nebꞌaneꞌ. As la oksal veꞌt eqꞌii taꞌn Aak unpajte tiꞌ u bꞌaꞌnileꞌ uveꞌ kat ibꞌan u Tiixheꞌ sqiꞌ setukꞌ taꞌn u Kubꞌaal Jesucristoeꞌ tan aꞌ vibꞌaꞌnil u Tiixheꞌ kat ibꞌan sqiꞌ setukꞌ.
